app.title: ctld-tools — CTLD Configuration
help.lang: Language for output (en, fr). Defaults to the OS locale.
tui.choose.add: What do you want to add?
tui.choose.patch: What do you want to patch?
tui.choose.remove: What do you want to remove?
tui.family.aa.description: Anti-air crate categories and MANPAD parameters.
tui.family.beacon.description: TACAN/ADF beacon parameters for FOB and extraction zones.
tui.family.boarding.description: Boarding speed, proximity, and interaction parameters.
tui.family.crates.description: Crate weight, proximity, and movement parameters.
tui.family.general.description: Core mission parameters: enable/disable CTLD features, global counts and limits.
tui.family.jtac.description: JTAC designation, smoke marking, and laser parameters.
tui.family.mines.description: Mine deployment and proximity detection parameters.
tui.family.other.description: Miscellaneous parameters without a specific functional category.
tui.family.parachute.description: Parachute drop physics: descent rates, lateral drift, and altitude thresholds.
tui.family.recon.description: Reconnaissance layer detection ranges and reporting parameters.
tui.family.smoke.description: F10 smoke marker colours and behaviour.
tui.family.soldier_weights.description: Individual soldier weights used for transport capacity calculations.
tui.family.troops.description: Infantry boarding, count, and placement parameters.
tui.form.select_hint: Select an item in the catalogue to edit it.
tui.notify.nothing_selected: Select an entry in the tree first.
tui.ph.name: name (menu label)
tui.section.advanced.description: Low-level overrides — change only if you know the effect.
tui.section.ai_zones.description: Zones used by the CTLD AI logistic system.
tui.section.aircraft.description: Per-aircraft CTLD capabilities (crate slots, troop capacity, sling-load, etc.).
tui.section.crates.description: Crate catalogue — items helicopters can carry and deploy in the field.
tui.section.mission_lists.description: Lists of pilot callsigns, extractable groups, and logistic unit names.
tui.section.parameters.description: All scalar CTLD configuration parameters, organized by functional area.
tui.section.troop_zones.description: Zones where infantry groups can be picked up and deployed.
tui.section.troops.description: Infantry group templates that can be boarded and deployed from helicopters.
tui.section.vehicle_weights.description: Override the weight of DCS ground vehicles for whole-vehicle transport.
tui.section.wp_zones.description: Zones that act as helicopter waypoints on the F10 map.
tui.section.zones.description: DCS trigger zones used by CTLD for troop pickup, waypoints, and AI logistics.
